title: Binance Wallet Exclusive TGE: Applications Now Open for Early-Stage Projects
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, We are excited to invite projects to apply for Binance Wallet Exclusive TGE, a unique opportunity to fairly launch your token, access Binance’s diverse user base, and prepare for accelerated growth. What Is Binance Wallet Exclusive TGE: Exclusive TGE stands for “Exclusive Token Generation Event”. Binance Wallet helps small and medium-sized promising projects launch their tokens fairly and reach an engaged, real user base through Exclusive TGE events. Once launched, the token will be featured in  Binance Alpha , a platform showcasing early-stage crypto projects with growth potential and serving as a pre-listing selection pool for Binance Exchange. Additionally, projects can benefit from Binance Wallet’s liquidity support to bootstrap on-chain liquidity.  Key Benefits to Launch with Binance Wallet Exclusive TGE: Placement on Binance Alpha:  Showcase your project to investors and users in Binance Wallet’s early-stage project hub, which serves as a pre-listing selection pool for Binance Exchange. Access to Verified Users : Engage with the real, verified, and vast user base at Binance Wallet. Fair Token Distribution : Ensure transparent token allocation design through predefined mechanisms. On-Chain Liquidity Support : Leverage Binance Wallet’s liquidity support and infrastructure to bootstrap seamless trading on-chain. Global Exposure : Benefit from Binance Wallet’s ecosystem, marketing, and user engagement. Accelerated Growth : Leverage Binance Wallet’s network to drive adoption and long-term success. How Are Projects Shortlisted: There is no one-size-fits-all framework, but we prioritize projects that demonstrate: A product with proven market fit A vibrant community with strong user adoption A strong and dedicated founding team  A sustainable value accrual system and tokenomics design Embracements of Binance Ecosystem and BNB Chain A low-to-medium valuation as an early-stage project with growth potential How to Apply: Interested projects can fill out the online application form for Binance Wallet Exclusive TGE  here . After submission, our team will conduct rigorous due diligence and  only reach out to selected projects , please be responsive and professional to help expedite the process. Please note that being contacted  does not guarantee  selection for Binance Wallet Exclusive TGE. Final approval is subject to further evaluation and internal review. Submit Your Application Now For More Information: How to Apply for Binance Wallet-Exclusive TGE Introducing Binance Alpha: Discover Emerging Crypto Projects Note:  There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise.Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-03-14
